gdprSubtitle: Deletion (anonymization) of the personal data of unenrolled pupils. Restricted to Management.
oblioBanner: Only unenrolled pupils and their parents. Permanent deletion anonymizes personal data (irreversible): audit logs and tax documents (invoices) are kept as required by law.
oblioNonSelezionato: Select a pupil to analyze and anonymize the data.
oblioAvviso: You are about to irreversibly anonymize the data of {nome}.
richiesteBanner: Requests started by parents from the app (Profile and delegates). Fulfilling them anonymizes the parent and their unenrolled children (irreversible); children still enrolled and tax documents remain. To be fulfilled within 30 days (GDPR).
richiesteNonSelezionato: Select a request to fulfill it.
richiesteAvviso: You are about to irreversibly anonymize the account of {nome}.
richiesteFigliFuoriScope: Children in another location, not affected here: {n}. The competent management must handle their part.
diarySubtitle: View today’s attendance (roll call stays with the teachers) and fill in/update the class diary.
diaryNessunaSezione: No nursery/preschool section in your locations. If that’s not what you expected, check that your user profile has an associated location (Directory → Staff).
diaryVuotoPresenti: No attendance recorded today: roll call hasn’t been done yet (switch to "All" to see the section anyway).
compitiEmptyAssegnati: You have no pending tasks to do right now.
compitiEmptyCreati: You haven’t created any staff tasks recently.
compitiEmptyTutti: No active tasks in your locations.
compitiEmptyArchivio: There are no completed tasks in the archive.
ricevutiIntro: Enrollment requests received from the standard form. Review them and import them into the records.
ricevutiReferente: Contact / account holder (receives the login account)
ricevutiImportNonCompletatoDesc: The request stays among those to import. Fix the indicated data and press «Import into records» again.
ricevutiCredInviate: Credentials sent by email to the contact.
ricevutiCredNonInviate: Email not sent: communicate the credentials manually.
ricevutiMostrate: {n, plural, one {Showing # request out of {totale}} other {Showing # requests out of {totale}}}
ricevutiDettaglioNonAperto: Request cannot be opened: reload the page or check the selected location.
inviabiliIntro: Customizable forms to send to parents via a link. Edit them in the builder and publish them to get the shareable link.
inviabiliStandardDesc: Public wizard, always active. Requests arrive in the «Received forms» tab. Editable from the builder.
inviabiliNessunModulo: No custom forms. Create one with «New form».
inviabiliResetConferma: Reset the standard enrollment form to its default values? Any changes made will be discarded.
inviabiliResetSuccess: Standard enrollment form restored to its default values.
inviabiliStandardSediNota: One link for all locations: the parent chooses the location in the first step of the form.

protTabelleAssenti: The register tables are not present in this database.

modSubtitle: Queue of reports received from parents and staff. Triage and handling reserved to the Management.
modSelezionaDettaglio: Select a report to see its details.
modCrossLinkSospese: Suspended conversations are handled in Messages → “All messages”.
inviabiliCandidatureDesc: Public «Work with us» form: applications arrive in the «Applications» tab. It does not go through the form builder and cannot be reset, because its fields end up in typed columns and in a closed list of age ranges in the database, not in free-form JSON.
inviabiliCandidatureSediNota: One link for all locations: applicants choose the location inside the form.
candIntro: Applications received from the public «Work with us» form. Management approves or rejects them: approving one creates the teacher account and sends the credentials.
candSelezionaDettagli: Select an application to see its details.
candMostrate: {n, plural, one {Showing # application out of {totale}} other {Showing # applications out of {totale}}}
candCvBloccato: The browser blocked the CV from opening in a new tab.
candSoloDirezione: Only Management can approve or reject: approving creates a teacher account, which can read the children’s records.
candRuoloInCorso: Checking your role: in a moment we will know whether this account can decide.
candSospesaTesto: The teacher account WAS CREATED and the credentials have already been generated, but the application is not marked as approved. Do not press “Approve” again and do not reject it: report it to support.
candSospesaAzioniSpente: Approve and Reject stay off while the application is being approved: the account already exists, and rejecting it would send a rejection email to someone who has just received their credentials.
candConfermaApprovaAccount: A teacher account will be created for
candConfermaApprovaCredenziali: The credentials will be sent to
candConfermaApprovaFasceMancanti: No age range specified: they will have to be assigned by hand from the Staff panel.
candConfermaRifiutaTesto: The application will be filed as rejected. No account is created for
candMotivoAiuto: It is an internal note: it stays with the office and never goes into the email.
candAvvisaEmailNota: A courtesy email, with no reasons. Off on purpose: turn it on only if you really want to write.
candEsitoPresaInCarico: Taken on: closing did NOT complete
candCredenzialiAvviso: They are shown only once: write them down now. Once this card is closed they cannot be read again and can only be regenerated from the Staff panel.
candCredNonInviate: Email NOT sent: the account exists anyway and the person does not know how to sign in. Share the credentials manually.
candNessunaCredenziale: No password generated: an account with this email already existed.
candEsitoEmailNonInviata: No outcome email sent: the application is rejected anyway.
candErroreElenco: The applications could not be loaded: please try again shortly.
candErrorePagina: More applications could not be loaded: please try again shortly.
candErroreAzione: The operation could not be completed: please try again shortly.
candErroreCv: The CV cannot be opened right now: please try again shortly.
candDettaglioNonAperto: The application cannot be opened: reload the page or check the selected location.
candElencoNonLetto: The list could not be read: there is no way to know whether any applications are waiting. Try again, and if the problem persists contact support.
candEsitoScartatoPre: The outcome of the action on
candEsitoScartatoPost: was not shown in its own panel: in the meantime that panel had been closed, or another application had been opened.
candScartatoAccountCreato: The teacher account WAS CREATED. In the list the row will say “Approved” and nothing more: everything you need to know is right here.
candScartatoAccountCreatoAMeta: The teacher account WAS CREATED, but the application is not marked as approved: do not press “Approve” again and report it to support.
candScartatoRespinta: The server refused the action and it did not go through: open the application again from the list to see the state it is in.
candScartatoSenzaRisposta: No answer ever arrived: there is no way to know whether the action went through. Open the application again from the list before repeating it.
candAzioneInCorso: An action on this application is still running: Approve and Reject stay off until the answer arrives, so it cannot be sent twice.
